title: StrictPRMBench: A Replayable Evaluation Benchmark for Auditing Fixed-Score PRM Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) score reasoning steps, but best-of-N selection also requires a rule that aggregates those scores. We study that rule as a separate evaluation object. StrictPRMBench fixes mathematical reasoning pools, scorer evidence, and the source trace of a deletion intervention, so that different reducers face the same recorded selection problem. Across seven scoring checkpoints and two benchmarks, the stored N=32 outcomes give higher deletion-induced selection instability for product than geometric mean (GM) in all 14 cells. The equal-cell difference is +0.0965; a shared-problem bootstrap, conditional on these checkpoints and frozen pools, gives a 95% interval of [0.0846,0.1086]. A pre-injection-defined sensitivity excludes replacement slots that are either reducer's clean winner and retains 4,459 of 4,622 cell-problem records. translated_title: StrictPRMBench：一个用于审计固定分数PRM聚合的可重放评估基准
translated_abstract: 过程奖励模型对推理步骤进行评分，但best-of-N选择还需要一个聚合这些分数的规则。我们将该规则作为一个独立的评估对象进行研究。StrictPRMBench固定了数学推理题池、评分器证据以及删除干预的源轨迹，使得不同的聚合方法面对相同的已记录选择问题。在七个评分检查点和两个基准测试上，存储的N=32结果在全部14个单元格中都显示乘积聚合比几何平均（GM）产生更高的删除诱发选择不稳定性。等单元格差异为+0.0965；在这些检查点和冻结题池条件下的共享问题自助法给出95%置信区间[0.0846,0.1086]。一项预注入定义的敏感性分析排除了任一聚合方法干净获胜者所在的替换槽位，保留了4,622个单元格-问题记录中的4,459条，保留后的差异为+0.0986 [0.0875,0.1098]。效应呈现异质性：两个Qwen ce……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出StrictPRMBench可重放评估基准，将PRM分数聚合规则作为独立评估对象进行审计，通过固定数学推理题池与删除干预轨迹确保不同聚合方法面对相同的选择问题，发现乘积聚合在所有测试条件下都比几何平均产生更高的删除诱发选择不稳定性。
en_tdlr: StrictPRMBench is a replayable evaluation benchmark that audits fixed-score PRM aggregation rules as independent evaluation objects, finding that product aggregation exhibits higher deletion-induced selection instability than geometric mean across all 14 tested cells.
